name: VRM_POL_BILLING_EVENTS_GT
description: Oracle internal use only. This global temporary table is used in import billing data job during internal processing.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation line identifier to which this event belongs.

columns.name: BILLING_LINE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Billing line detail unique identifier pointing to the billing record coming from the billing system.

columns.name: BILL_ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Accounting date on which billed amount is posted in contract revenue clearing account in billing system.

columns.name: RECURRING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the line will recur on the line's satisfaction plan end date. Valid values are from the lookup type VRM_YES/NO.

columns.name: DEVOLVE_PO_FLAG
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates if the performance obligation of this billing event is devolved. A performance obligation is devolved if the Devolve performance obligation option is set to Yes in either the performance obligation identification rule or the implied obligation template that was used during identification of the performance obligations.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Contract's eligibility for adjustment by the Residual Account Balance Write Off process. Values are from the lookup type ORA_ADJUSTMENT_STATUS.
